notes: Disaster-recovery / durability config for Blueprint's AUTHORITATIVE data
(Firestore control-plane + GCS storage buckets), GCP project blueprint-8c1ca.
Firestore is protected by a scheduled managed export to a SEPARATE backup bucket;
the primary storage buckets are protected by object versioning + a soft-delete window.
What is committed config vs a human/dashboard step is called out per field and in the runbook.

firestore_export.note: collection_ids empty = export ALL collections (whole authoritative control-plane). Scheduled via the committed systemd timer scaffold (deploy/systemd/blueprint-firestore-backup.timer) OR a Cloud Scheduler + Firestore managed-backup job created in the console (documented human step).

storage_buckets.note: Raw capture truth + derived/hosted artifacts. Object versioning + soft-delete are the bucket DR mechanism (recover overwritten/deleted objects). Enabling versioning is a human/gcloud step; retention floor mirrors the capture-truth floor.
Dedicated backup bucket for Firestore exports. MUST be distinct from the primary bucket so a primary-bucket incident cannot take out the backups. Restrict IAM to the backup service account.

restore.note: Import is the inverse of export. Restore to a NON-default recovery database first, verify, then cut over. Full step-by-step in the runbook.
